name: Ema
source: The sole member of the two-person group, the "Crimson Wings." A girl of few words, it is difficult to ascertain what she's thinking about. However, her trust and loyalty to Akane are unwavering. Although still doubtful of Akane and Ema, Kusuhara joins forces with the two. Later, he learns about the hidden past of the two members of the Crimson Wings.
